name: Katana Standard
description: Katana Standard, edition 1: Katana's own linestyles, symbols, layers and colours for 632 survey codes, with 98 linestyles and 123 symbols. The survey code keys are the other built-in library's, for field-data compatibility.
notice: Katana Standard was made for Katana: its linestyles, symbols, layers, colours and words are Katana's own.
Its survey code keys, what each key stands for and the kinds of rule each key has are those of the other built-in library, kept so that the same field data works with either, on the owner's decision.
Its licence is that of the Katana repository, whose LICENSING.md says what that leaves open for the keys.
